reason: The append-only fit-grid follow-up locked fit grid 61, but its frozen 41-vs-81 EAP gate failed because median and p95 reference-theta shifts were too large. This second append-only follow-up tests denser EAP grids without changing thresholds or refitting grid 61.

parent_study.reuse_policy: Hash-verify and copy the completed grid-61 ridge-0.1 fit and EAP-81 score artifacts; do not refit or rescore them.

eap_grid_lock_rule.description: Run both successive comparisons. Lock 81 only if both pass. If 81-vs-161 fails but 161-vs-321 passes, lock 161. Otherwise make no EAP lock.

threshold_change_policy: No threshold may be relaxed after observing follow-up results.
downstream_policy: Nested CAT work remains provisional until the two-human InFoBench Qwen audit passes.
